subject.title: feat: a best-in-class Usage & Spend dashboard — model/tool views, accurate spend, token activity heatmap

question: Should the new dashboard present a separate billing-vendor attribution view alongside tool-based usage, with provider-reported and locally estimated costs explicitly distinguished?
rationale: The patch makes a durable user-facing interpretation choice for mixed-provider workflows; source inspection can verify mechanics, but cannot determine whether this accounting model is the product contract maintainers want.

options.title: Approve the dual attribution model
options.body: Keep separate tool and billing-vendor views, require clear estimated versus provider-reported labeling, and land after the concrete correctness fixes.

options.title: Limit scope to tool-based usage
options.body: Keep the model and client history but defer billing-vendor reattribution until a narrower product design is approved.

options.title: Defer the dashboard redesign
options.body: Retain the current provider-oriented view and revisit the broader model and billing dashboard after the design discussion is resolved.

recommendation.title: Approve the dual attribution model
recommendation.body: Keep separate tool and billing-vendor views, require clear estimated versus provider-reported labeling, and land after the concrete correctness fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: The open canonical design discussion requires repository-level product acceptance rather than a mechanical patch decision.
